title: Children with Easter Baskets on Lawn, 1953 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black and white snapshot from Easter 1953 depicting two young children sitting outdoors on a green suburban lawn with their Easter baskets. The young girl on the left wears a classic bonnet and coat dress, while the boy beside her wears a striped blazer and shorts. In the background sits a 1950s sedan parked in front of a house garage, capturing post-WWII American suburban domestic life.
